model_annotation: This nested donut chart displays two related distributions, with the outer ring representing "Ambiguity Std" and the inner ring representing "Max Ambiguity." The outer ring consists of four slices: a dark blue segment corresponding to "Std: 0.0" that accounts for 49.0%, a medium blue segment for "Std: 0.47" at 39.0%, a light blue segment for "Std: 0.94" at 7.0%, and a light-medium blue segment for "Std: 0.82" at 5.0%. The inner ring comprises three slices arranged clockwise in descending order of size: a medium-light blue segment labeled "Max: 1" at 47.7%, a lighter blue segment for "Max: 2" at 38.0%, and a very light blue segment for "Max: 3" at 14.2%. Bolded percentage labels are positioned directly inside their respective slices, utilizing white text for the outer ring and black text for the inner ring. None of the segments are visually emphasized through explosion or offsetting.
